note: U1 is a stateless library: no process, no endpoint, no database, no network, no stored data. Most inception NFRs describe a running service and are marked N/A with that structural reason stated per row, rather than omitted. Three bind directly (NFR9, NFR17, NFR10 in the narrow mapping sense) and one binds indirectly (NFR7, via dependency weight).

coverage.target: NFR9.1, NFR9.2, NFR9.3, NFR9.8, NFR9.9, NFR9.10, NFR9.11

NFR9.10 — this Unit owns the single storage-type mapping to NUMERIC(12,2) that targets the encrypted column; the encryption itself is infrastructure and belongs to the hosting decision, not to this Unit
NFR9.16 — binds indirectly: the near-empty dependency surface is what keeps this Unit from adding runtime weight to a single 2 GB instance under the USD 50/month ceiling
Android SDK level. This Unit contributes a Kotlin value class to the shared model package but sets no SDK target; U10 release-packaging owns the build configuration
Device floor and AAB download size. A value class and its serializer add negligible size and no runtime requirement; the size gate belongs to U10

NFR9.22, NFR9.23, NFR9.24 — corrected at review from N/A. The earlier N/A reason (owns no screen, no string resource, no layout) was true but dodged NFR3's substance: BR5.4 and contract-summary §B.5 put ALL locale digit rendering and separator placement in THIS Unit and forbid the client from formatting, so the Bangla-digits half of NFR3 is this Unit's obligation and nobody else's. The screen-and-layout half remains every screen-bearing Unit's. The rendering itself is unspecified upstream and is recorded as OQ-B1-1
Offline reads. No cache, no persistence, no staleness concept in this Unit
Offline writes. This Unit performs no write of any kind; U5 owns the queued mid-class path
Queue semantics and the four states. No queue in this Unit; U5 owns it

Scale ceiling of 100 teachers and a few thousand students. A pure function has no scale dimension; the fold's linear complexity is recorded in the Functional Design rather than as an NFR target, and ADR-002's escalation trigger belongs to U7 which owns the query
Data residency. No data stored and no region selected by this Unit
Device identifiers. This Unit reads no device state and transmits nothing; the forbidden-identifier gates are U10's, applied to the merged manifest and the minified release build
OTP abuse controls. No authentication surface in this Unit; U3 owns all seven controls
Per-purpose SMS budget. No gateway adapter in this Unit; U3 owns it
Token lifetimes and refresh rotation. No tokens in this Unit; U3 owns the token lifecycle

Privacy boundary in three layers. This Unit owns no table, no row-level security policy and no response schema carrying profile fields. It cannot leak personal data because it never receives any — it sees an amount and an entry kind, never a name or an identifier. U3 and U11 own the boundary; U2 owns the schema-wide invariant
Accessibility and back-stack behaviour. No UI surface in this Unit
API versioning and additive change. This Unit defines the money field's wire form but owns no endpoint and no version policy; U2 owns the contract and its diff gate
